design_vision: An 'Editorial Science' aesthetic that moves away from generic corporate blue. It uses high-contrast typography, strict Swiss-style grids, and warm off-white backgrounds paired with a strong Rust Orange accent to evoke industrial energy, precision, and authority. The design should feel premium, serious, and deeply trustworthy.

mono.styling: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em] for labels, CAS numbers, and overlines

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-charcoal
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-charcoal

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6 to p-12 for internal card padding, py-24 to py-32 for section padding.

borders_and_radius.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px) for a sharp, technical industrial feel.
borders_and_radius.borders: 1px solid border-border. Use 'Grid Borders' style for data-heavy sections to expose the skeleton.

components.buttons: Square edges, high contrast. Primary: bg-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#E85D04] text-white transition-colors duration-300. Include data-testid.
components.cards: Flat background (bg-surface), 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F9F8]/80) with 1px bottom border.
components.footer: Massive spacing (py-24). High contrast (Dark charcoal background, off-white text).
components.badges: Used for CAS numbers and Purity tags. Font-mono, small, muted background.

interactive_and_motion.hover: Explicit hover states on all interactives. Color shifts towards Accent (#E85D04) for engagement.
interactive_and_motion.transitions: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease
interactive_and_motion.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, product cards, and form inputs (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-cta-button', data-testid='product-card-toluene').

hero_background.description: Abstract macro liquid with orange/brown industrial tones. Use with a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F9F9F8]/90 to-[#F9F9F8]/40) so text is highly legible.

industry_manufacturing.description: Industrial workshop with lathe and metal shavings.

industry_printing.description: Detailed view of an industrial printing press.

about_facility.description: Vast industrial factory floor with machinery.

content_structure.hero: H1: 'Precision Solvents for Modern Industry'. Subtitle: High-purity chemical solutions for paints, pharma, and beyond. CTA: 'View Product Catalog' and 'Contact via WhatsApp'.
content_structure.industries_bento: Showcase Paints & Coatings, Pharmaceuticals, Printing & Inks, Cleaning. Use strict grid, large numbers (01, 02) in mono font.
content_structure.product_catalog: Grid of realistic chemical cards. E.g., 'Toluene (CAS: 108-88-3) - Aromatic', 'Isopropyl Alcohol (CAS: 67-63-0) - Alcohols'. Fields: Name, CAS, Purity (e.g. 99.5%), Applications.
content_structure.about_and_stats: Text-heavy editorial layout detailing quality commitment. Counters: Years in Business, Products, Industries Served.
content_structure.contact_and_footer: Direct WhatsApp integration (no form). Map placeholder. Business Address: Sukadkatte, Bangalore 560091.

technical_instructions.icons: lucide-react for sharp, consistent UI icons.
technical_instructions.animations: Framer Motion for scroll-triggered entrance animations (staggered lists, fade up).
technical_instructions.routing: Use React Router for Home, About, Products, Industries, Contact pages.
technical_instructions.testing: All critical interactive elements MUST have semantic data-testid attributes.
